en.title: Build reusable Hub API tools
en.description: Combine Hugging Face API calls into reusable scripts with clear inputs and outputs.
tasks: Combine Hugging Face API calls into reusable scripts with clear inputs and outputs.
prerequisites: A shell or Python/Node runtime, network access, and HF_TOKEN when required.
en.example: Use huggingface-tool-builder. Build a script that finds models linked to this paper and exports their metadata as JSON.
en.expectedResult: A reusable script with --help, authentication handling, and explicit output structure.
limitations: Rate limits and private-resource permissions still apply.

zh.title: 构建 Hub API 工具
zh.description: 把 Hugging Face API 调用组合成输入输出清晰的可复用脚本。
tasks: 把 Hugging Face API 调用组合成输入输出清晰的可复用脚本。
prerequisites: Shell 或 Python/Node 环境、网络，以及必要时的 HF_TOKEN。
zh.example: 请使用 huggingface-tool-builder：编写脚本查找与此论文关联的模型，并导出 JSON 元数据。
zh.expectedResult: 带 --help、鉴权处理和明确输出结构的脚本。
limitations: 仍受 API 限流与私有资源权限限制。
